newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to acquire car dealers.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to acquire car dealers.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said it agreed to acquire two New Jersey-based car dealership groups for about $55 million in stock.
Republic said it agreed to acquire Flemington Car and Truck Country and Princeton's Nassau Conover's family of dealerships.
The dealerships sell and service vehicles under several brand names including Ford, Lincoln-Mercury, Volkswagen, Porsche, Audi, BMW, Buick, Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep-Eagle, Mazda, Infiniti and Nissan.
Republic Industries gained 1-1/4 to 35 and was one of the most active Nasdaq issues on Wednesday.
